text:
Maya (CSM): Heads up — account AcmeRetail is showing an onboarding 'tilt' this week. Activation metrics dipped ~35% and ff-signal-bot flagged it. Renewal in ~45 days. Suspect they're hitting embedding cost surprises + a couple integration failures. Need a short churn-deflection plan.

Ethan (AM): Thanks. Can you drop the signal summary here? I can push a pricing promo if finance will ok it.

Maya (CSM): Summary from ff-signal-bot below: 
- DAU: 18 -> 9 over 10 days
- Integration errors: 4% -> 12% (mostly on batch upload)
- Top feedback: "Embedding costs confusing", "Prompts not returning consistent results"
- Renewal date: 2026-05-06

Priya (Enablement): I can run a 20-min focused enablement session next Tue. Quick ask: can we surface their top 3 flows + sample prompts? I’ll tailor a cost/optimization section (batching + caching).

Luca (CS Ops): Proposal: try a lightweight "tilt & tether" micro-play to deflect churn: 
```
1) 1:1 enablement + live walkthrough of their 3 flows (Priya)
2) Short-term promo: 10% credit on embedding units for 30 days (Ethan -> finance)
3) Ops changes: enable prefix caching and set safe batching for heavy uploads (Luca -> infra)
4) 14-day success checkpoint with a small A/B prompt set and a 2-question survey to capture feedback
5) If no recovery, offer structured downgrade to Essentials tier with usage guardrails (clear rollback path)
```

Maya (CSM): That checklist looks good. Who will own the promo coordination? @Ethan?

Ethan (AM): Yes, I’ll start the finance thread now and request a small, time-limited credit. Also will ask Product to temporarily whitelist a higher batch size for them. ETA EOD.

Priya (Enablement): I'll draft the 20-min deck + a 1-page checklist for the session. Feedback capture plan: 
- Pre-call: collect 3 sample prompts + list of slow endpoints
- During: show token/cost per workflow + 2 quick wins to cut tokens
- Post-call: 2-question survey (did this help reduce cost confusion? yes/no), small NPS ask
I’ll drop the deck link in this thread when ready.

ff-signal-bot: [automated] account_flag: onboarding_tilt -> severity: medium

Luca (CS Ops): I’ll own the 14-day checkpoint doc and the downgrade path doc. I’ll also coordinate infra toggles with eng-infra and ping legal for promo terms. Will publish the micro-play to /cs-playbooks after we validate.

Maya (CSM): Assigning owners: Maya=CX lead (coord), Ethan=promo/pricing, Priya=enablement session, Luca=ops/checkpoint. Reconvene in 48h for status. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
